contracts.rule: engines are spawned by path, never imported; engines do not import experiments
the paringest baseline and conveyor workers use the same worker observation producer; vanilla remains an upstream reference target
conveyor segment generation equals delivery quota; baseline over-generation remains explicit arm behavior

paringest baseline and conveyor validation reject Step errors, session death, client-health failure, and measured per-session short delivery after first full delivery; a session that never reaches full delivery also fails; vanilla is reference-only
formal seeded evidence requires all seed prefill before ticks, excludes seed output from inventory, performs no finalization park, and rejects barrier timeout logs

park runs on an idle scheduler transition, records mirror coverage, and exposes uncovered-tail recomputation instead of silently claiming a complete reload; LARGE-prefill review is currently offline, not a status gate
verification: park.log coverage and offline scheduler/Perfetto recompute review

contracts.rule: registry lifecycle is a control-phase hint; block pools, request status, and transfer events own actual residency and readiness

the pinned client uses non-namespaced /tmp shard files and shared ports, so runs must not overlap; managed workflow deletes stale shard and aggregate files, requires every expected shard plus the controller to recreate results, and cleans temporary files on exit
prefetch changes latency only; refusal, delay or eviction falls back to demand reload
formal evidence is clean; dirty diagnostic evidence carries a reconstructable patch artifact
